description: Broadcasts a signed EVM transaction (a swap built by /evm/swap/order, or any other) on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC or Avalanche through a public RPC and waits up to 25 seconds for the receipt. Returns the hash, an explorer link and success, failed or pending with block number and gas used. The wallet keeps its keys; nothing is custodied. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the receipt, 0-25 (default 15)
